summary: Completed backend and frontend verification for CSV/XLSX merge behavior, WhatsApp-duplicate update rules, date parsing, outlet mapping, upload copy note, login, and sample data restoration on public URL.
action_items: No product bug found in requested scope; keep regression tests and rerun serially for stateful upload flows.
Optional hardening: ensure CI exports REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before pytest to avoid full-suite skips.
critical_code_review_comments: Stateful dashboard dataset can cause flaky failures when test files run in parallel workers; serial run (-n 0) is reliable for current mutable integration flows.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data added. Uploaded temporary CSV test payloads and restored sample data after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested merge/outlet/login flows passed on public URL. Backend pytest: 24 passed (serial). UI validated: merge-note text visible, outlet header visible, first upload replaces sample baseline, second upload adds unique and updates duplicate by newer date, third older duplicate does not overwrite, sample restored at end.
rca of the issue: No product defect found. Initial failures were test-environment/test-isolation issues: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was not exported in shell (causing skips) and mutable dataset tests were flaky under parallel workers. Mitigation: export env from frontend/.env before pytest and run stateful merge suite serially.
